artworks.title: Male Nude on Steps
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Walter Shirlaw, wife of the artist, 1912)
artworks.description: The image depicts a male figure in a dynamic pose. He is standing on a square block with his left foot and his right leg is bent, resting on a lower step. His right arm is raised above his head, holding a long chisel or similar tool, while his left arm is extending forward with his hand placed on a large rounded stone or surface. His head is slightly bowed, and he is looking downward with a focused expression. He has short hair. The man is nude, and there are no visible clothing or accessories. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Study for "Marbles"
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and black ink on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing with two main sections. The left side shows a shaded sketch of a figure seated in a chair. The right side features overlapping circular forms, with the word "MARBLES" written prominently. Hand-written notes and lines suggest instructions or edits. The drawing appears loose and informal, indicating a work in progress. Top left corner notes say, "Change as indicated."

artworks.title: The Afterglow, Grand Canyon, Arizona
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1905)
artworks.description: The painting shows a view of a vast canyon landscape. The horizon is near the top third of the composition, separating the land and the sky. The tops of the canyon walls are depicted in warm tones of red, orange, and brown. Bold and expressive brushstrokes capture the textures and depths of the canyon surfaces. The reds, oranges, and browns of the tops of the canyons contrast with deep blues and purples in the shadows of the canyon walls. The sky shows muted greenish and grayish tones, suggesting a setting sun casting warm light across the formations.

artworks.title: Study for "Shad Fishing"
artworks.medium: pen and ink with gouache on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Claude J. Ranney, grandson of the artist, 1960)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a small boat in turbulent waters. The scene is depicted in pen and ink on sepia-toned paper. The boat is in the center, navigating choppy waves. The figures in the boat are working together, holding long poles towards the water. The background is cross-hatched, suggesting depth and atmosphere. The expressions and poses of the figures convey urgency and action. The lines are precise and energetic, capturing the setting effectively. The overall tone is monochromatic with a contrast between dark lines and the light paper, emphasizing the vintage style.

artworks.title: Seascape with Rocks
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the National Academy of Design, Mrs. William F. Brewster Bequest, 1953)

artworks.title: Seascape
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the National Academy of Design, Mrs. William F. Brewster Bequest, 1953)
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal scene viewed from the shore looking towards the sea. The horizon line is placed high in the composition, slightly above the center. The watercolor technique used features delicate brushstrokes, creating a soft quality. The color palette includes shades of grey with hints of darker tones for depth. The beach is depicted with wet sand leading to the water. The scene fades into surrounding white space, focusing on the central seascape vignette.

artworks.title: Rocks and Breaking Waves
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache on tan wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of the National Academy of Design, Mrs. William F. Brewster Bequest, 1953)
artworks.description: This painting shows a seascape, with the horizon low in the scene. There are waves crashing towards us, approaching a rocky brown outcropping on the left side. The color palette includes shades of pale blue, gray, and green, and the waves are topped with streaks of white. The sky is cloudy and gray with some hints of pale yellow, and there are small birds flying above the waves.

artworks.title: The Bell Buoy
artworks.medium: watercolor with white highlights over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Charles C. Glover, Jr., 1958)
artworks.description: This painting shows a scene of an ocean with choppy waves under a cloudy sky. The crashing waves are depicted with white, blue, and green colors. A buoy is seen in the sea off to the right, tilted to the side. The water and sky are highlighted with pale streaks of pink. The painting is surrounded by an off-white border that some of the paint colors seem to bleed into.

artworks.title: Foliage
artworks.medium: graphite and gouache on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection

artworks.title: Evening, San Giorgio Maggiore, Venice
artworks.medium: charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of  Mrs. Eugene Vail, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape in the distance across a body of water. The horizon is located towards the lower third of the image, lined by dark shapes including a tall tower and a domed structure. The artwork features soft, diffuse brushstrokes likely made with charcoal or a similar medium, creating a hazy atmosphere. The color scheme is minimalistic, using shades of sepia and gray. In the foreground, there are dark silhouettes resembling small boats with figures against the water reflecting soft lights.

artworks.title: Paintings
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior featuring a grand staircase, two large vases, and busts on pedestals. The image showcases three arches at the top of the staircase. The artistry shows intricate shading and line work detailing the arches and ornaments. The vases have floral designs, and the busts are made of marble. The drawing hints at columns and arches beyond the staircase, suggesting an expansive space.

artworks.title: 1892 Corcoran Gallery of Art Catalogue
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate frame design. The image shows an intricately detailed frame with decorative foliage patterns both at the top and bottom. At the bottom, there is a ribbon-like embellishment with the text "W.W. Corcoran" inscribed on it. The frame appears to be designed for a portrait, as indicated by the handwritten note within the empty frame area. The design exhibits a meticulous linework style.

artworks.title: The Corcoran Gallery of Art
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative frame design. The drawing features an ornate border with intricate botanical illustrations accentuating the corners and edges. In the top right corner, there are detailed line drawings of leaves. The bottom part of the frame includes a ribbon-like embellishment that curls and twists. Inside the frame, it is labeled with the text "The Corcoran Gallery of Art." The main section where an image or photograph would be placed is left blank, with the text "Photo of Beecham" penciled softly in the center.

artworks.title: Electrotype Reproductions
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing on a pedestal. The drawing shows a person in a period costume, including tights and a tunic. The figure is set against an abstract background with patterns and lines. The entire composition is in black ink with detailed linework for texture and depth. At the bottom, there is a handwritten note stating, "Letter to be 3/4 inch long."

artworks.title: Casts from Antique Sculpture: The Parthenon
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts two drawn sculptures. One sculpture is of a reclining figure resting on a decorative frieze with figures in low relief along the background. The second sculpture is of a standing nude male figure, posed with one arm slightly raised and the other relaxed beside his body. The sketches are in monochrome, resembling stone sculptures, showcasing detailed human forms.

artworks.title: History of the Corcoran Gallery of Art
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove tracing paper partially mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural design with a large letter "H" in the foreground. The drawing features an entrance to a building with decorative columns, a triangular pediment above the door, climbing plants or vines, a circular plaque above the door, and leafy adornments. The letter "H" is intricately intertwined with ribbons and foliage in front of the architectural scene, suggesting a possible monogram or decorative initial. The drawing uses fine lines and shading to capture the intricate details and elegance of the architecture and its embellishments.

artworks.title: A Beached Longboat
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of J. William Middendorf, II, 1977)
artworks.description: The image shows an empty boat on a sandy shoreline viewed from slightly above. The horizon is distant with the sea stretching towards it, and there are indistinct shapes on the water. The drawing is intricate, done in pencil with detailed lines and shading depicting textures of the sand and the boat. The color palette is monochromatic in grey and beige. The weathered boat is shown with detailed shadows and structure, along with textiles or tarps. In the background, there are minimalistic elements adding to the calm and expansive feel of the scene.

artworks.title: Crévera! Crévera pas!
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene showing an ominous cloud labelled "DISSOLUTION" passing over a classical building. The drawing shows a gathering of individuals, portrayed from the back, seemingly observing an impending situation. The building on the left resembles a Greek or Roman temple, with the word "LEGISLATIVE" visible on its frieze. The looming black cloud suggests chaos or trouble, with a simple composition and minimal shading focusing on conveying a message of tension and foreboding.

artworks.title: Garden Front, Speke, Lancashire
artworks.medium: hand-colored lithograph on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: The image shows the detailed facade of a Tudor-style building, with elaborate half-timbered patterns and large mullioned windows. The scene includes the building against a cloudy sky, lush vegetation, and figures engaging in various activities.

artworks.title: Broadcasting Station
artworks.medium: aquatint and softground etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in a sketch or print, shown from the waist up. One figure holds a child, with their faces in close proximity. The adult figures have indistinct facial features and short hair. The child's features are slightly more discernible. The figures' clothing is rendered in shades of gray without intricate detail. The background shows a textured wall and a window above, hinting at an interior setting. No jewelry or objects are visible, aside from the child.

artworks.title: Mission Santa Barbara, Looking South
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image features a large building with a domed tower on the right side. The horizon shows hills, trees, and the sky. The brushstrokes give detailed texture to the scene, with a focus on the landscape and architecture. The color palette is sepia-toned. A tree, fence, smaller buildings, and a figure on a path add depth and perspective to the scene.

artworks.title: Mission San Juan Capistrano
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view of an architectural ruin, potentially part of the San Juan Capistrano Mission, seen from ground level. The horizon is positioned about a third from the top of the image, with distant hills extending across it as a backdrop. The ruin consists of weathered stone structures with arched doorways and large, partially collapsed arches, flanked by remaining portions of walls. Nearby, the ground appears uneven and covered with wild grasses. In the distance, arches supported by columns connect adjacent buildings that frame a courtyard area. The artwork style is akin to an etching or engraving, with fine, detailed lines and varied line density contributing to a textured look. The color palette is mainly monochromatic, featuring shades of brown and beige for a sepia-toned appearance, enhancing the historic atmosphere. A few birds are visible in the sky, adding a sense of movement to the stillness of the ruins.

artworks.title: Honorable John Bell
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper mounted to gilded wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is sitting upright and facing forward with a serious expression. The man has prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, and a stern mouth. His dark hair is slicked back. He wears formal clothing - a dark coat, a white shirt with a high stiff collar, and a dark cravat. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain, with an oval border around the portrait. The entire image has a sepia tone. The inscription at the bottom identifies him as Hon. John Bell and notes his candidacy for the presidency in 1860.

artworks.title: John the Baptist and the Lamb
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure, positioned cross-legged on the ground with one arm resting on a staff. The person has strong facial features, a beard, curly hair, and is wearing a textured garment. They hold a staff with a ribbon. Surrounding elements include a tree, a ram, vegetation, flowers, and a sky with birds.
